ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The diagram shows some of the organisms in a food web. Which organisms shown in the diagram are primary consumers?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left side of the image is labeled Plant, and arrows point respectively from Plant to aphid, caterpillar, and whitefly. The image also shows aphid pointing to ladybird, caterpillar pointing to bird, whitefly pointing to spider, and ladybird and spider again pointing to bird. Reasoning: primary consumers are organisms that directly feed on producers/plants. In this food web, the organisms that directly receive arrows from Plant are the organisms that directly eat plants. Therefore, the primary consumers shown in the image are aphid, caterpillar, and whitefly.
